Finally, Applicant has agreed that Lake Jocassee will be kept in its present undeveloped state with no further commercial development around the lake's shoreline, with the exception of presently-planned and occurring activities such as timbering and future pumped storage needs.
Applicant has considered the possibility of providing "flushing" flows of water to Howard Creek, after construction of the Bad Creek Project, to assist in removing sediment accumulations. These flows could be provided through the stream diversion system in the Bad Creek Dam. Applicant states that final provisions for such releases would be determined and provided after construction of the project was completed.
